trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task to chase. Work through the roadmap in this guide — story first, then the 100% checklist, then the stranger strands and cleanup — and this trophy will be the last one to land. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 in difficulty and about 200 hours, with a single playthrough enough.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and finish it; the trophy unlocks automatically at the end of the mission. It is the first story trophy and cannot be missed. There are no gold-medal objectives to worry about, so just follow the mission prompts.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full; the trophy unlocks when the first main mission of Chapter 2 begins. It is automatic and story-locked, so it cannot be missed. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter, since the game has no mission replay.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2; the trophy lands when Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City. Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Chapter 2 is also when you unlock character switching after Coffee Break, so take the time to explore Vice City as it opens up.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3; the trophy unlocks after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Automatic and unmissable. By this point most of the map and the stranger questlines are open, so start the optional questlines as they appear.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4; the trophy pops after the final mission of the chapter, Starting From Zero. Automatic story trophy. Chapter 4 is where the big heists and bank vault robberies unlock, so it is worth clearing optional missions before moving on.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the game, which is also the last mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. The trophy unlocks the moment the story ends. After the credits you return to free-roam, so nothing is lost by finishing the story — all cleanup can happen afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It unlocks during the mission itself, automatically, and cannot be missed. Just play through the chapter’s main missions in order.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Automatic story trophy that unlocks during the mission. No special preparation is needed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child’s Play in Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable; it unlocks during the mission. Keep playing the main missions and it will come.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. Automatic story trophy. It is one of the late-game missions, so it lands naturally on the road to the finale.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable. The mission takes place at Vice City International Airport, which is also where the Catch Me If You Can trophy is earned — but that one is a separate free-roam stunt, not part of this mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. Automatic story trophy and the last mission-linked trophy before the finale. Finish the mission and it pops.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, tracked under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — a checklist that only becomes visible after the story ends, though progress made during the story already counts. The requirements are forgiving: roughly 60% of true completion, with most side quests not required and collectibles only partly required; you need any 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, and all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret’s quests. Finish the story first, then work the checklist in free-roam — nothing on it is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida; the 100% checklist needs 300, so you will pass 250 on the way. The four kinds are 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps — mix them freely and pick the easiest. Under the Bridges are the quickest: fly a plane under a bridge and it counts. Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or drone race, and performing a stunt. View the list under Touchpad, Progress, Activities, where each type shows how many you have done. Most are introduced by the story or marked with blue dumbbell icons on the map, and you will tick most of them off naturally while chasing other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 shooting range locations. The challenges are not overly hard, and gold medals are the only requirement — there are no mission gold medals elsewhere in the game. Work through each range’s challenges and use the best weapon for each discipline. Completing them also raises your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 drone race locations — 42 races in total. Each location hosts several races, and you need a win at each location, not in every single race. Drone races also count toward the 100% checklist, so finish all of them there.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations around Leonida. Each distinct race location you win counts once, so spread your wins across the map instead of repeating one favourite. Races count as an activity type too, so this also helps Master of None.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal’s fishing questline and beat him at his own challenge. Fishing is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish all of its levels at least once. There are four video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is found on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game; bonus challenges are not required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy’s questline and its final mission. The questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia: Andy calls, then texts her home address in Belville. Finish all five Andy quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one. All of Andy’s quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton’s questline and its final mission. Kenton is marked automatically in Chapter 1; after the mission Island Dreams he calls and is marked with the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests with the metal detector on the ocean floor and bring them back. Kenton becomes temporarily unavailable in Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3, so nothing is missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy’s questline and its final mission. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Finish all five Billy quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops. All of Billy’s quests remain available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — Kirk’s Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle’s McKittrick Farm jobs, Yago’s street races and Pilot Pete’s deliveries are confirmed to count, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. All strangers stay available in free-roam after the story, and you can track your count in the trophy list itself.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy’s questline and its final mission. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. Randy then hands you a wish list of 16 sports cars to steal and deliver to his garage in west Vice City — scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether they are on the list, and deliver them in good condition for more money. Finish the list and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone’s questline and its final mission. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty and is only available as Jason: purple markers point to Synthetic Labs around Vice City, which you must destroy in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Destroy enough labs and Tyrone gives you the second quest, Spin On This — shut the labs down and the trophy pops. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation spots in 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts as two. THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony. Follow her, choose Accept, and do the meditation before Chapter 1 ends, because that one never comes back. Every other spot stays available in free-roam; the final ones need both characters unlocked after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel’s questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text marking the quest Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Bret gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest, then marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he requests and bring them back to him. The questline is exclusive to Jason and stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card sets scattered around Leonida; you only need to finish any three. Cards are found in the world and tracked in your collections, so grab sets as you explore and finish three of them. Use a collectible map to find the cards for the sets nearest to you.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations. Hold Up on the D-pad and R1 to scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags — there are 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, far more than the 100 you need, so scan anything that glows as you travel. Scanning also feeds Whip It Good when you point it at vehicles.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. You need 70 of 80 for the 100% checklist, so this trophy pops automatically on the way to A Long Road. Track challenges under Progress, Challenges, and pick the easiest ones left — many complete naturally while you work on other trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, and escape the heat. This only becomes possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam with Jason and Lucia together — call your partner with Right on the D-pad plus Triangle. Cause enough chaos to reach 4 stars, then break out of the red heat zone; a fast sports bike through traffic works well, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a reliable escape route since helicopters cannot follow you there. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. After Coffee Break, call your partner, then hit three robbery targets in a row while the police stay on you — keep the flashing wanted level alive and do not let it drop. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, unlocked after Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3: loot a few items in each, break the safe with sticky bombs in the back room, and move on fast. If the trophy does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth — the unlock is delayed by about half a minute after you leave the last shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Open the WAiNK app on your phone — hold Up to use it instantly — and scan vehicles as they pass; you only need to scan them, not drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that goes by, and you will hit 100 fast. You need 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned for the 100% checklist, so this pops on the way there; check your totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming — time slows and weak points are highlighted, but the purple focus bar drains in seconds. Buff your focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, then line up five enemies at a gang operation and drop them fast with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so use gang members. Your Focus level rises as you play shooting ranges, golf, pool and fishing, and by Focus level 4 this gets much easier.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport and fly it away. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge and enter the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km away from the airport before the trophy pops — it is delayed, so keep flying. Planes parked on the open airfield do not count; it must be one connected to a boarding bridge.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank and use it. Tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance. Climb in, fire at some enemies, and the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance from the base, so bring armour and be ready to move fast.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it in, find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe without tripping the alarm. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies unlock in the Chapter 4 optional mission That’s Where The Money Is…: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, grab the cash with your partner’s help, and escape the 4-star wanted level on a fast bike. After that quest, pay Yasmani $10,000 for tips that mark security vans with purple icons. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this pops on the way; each vault pays up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is the same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults — robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Or do it earlier in free-roam: find an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on the back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius or use a Pay ’n’ Spray. Sticky bombs are sold at Ammu-Nation and in the back of Yasmani’s shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is completely visible. You will clear most of it naturally by travelling for other trophies, so save this for the end and sweep the remaining fog in one flight.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, marked with yellow icons when you get near them, and the 100% checklist needs all 39 — so this pops automatically on the way. Track each gang’s count under Progress, Gangs, where the bottom right shows how many of their operations you have robbed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed by the guide sites — PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known. Head to a bar or cocktail spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view; check the guide sources linked here for the confirmed method once it is published. The trophy is not missable, so it can be done any time in free-roam.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known. The name points to driving a car through the glass of a vehicle showroom; try the showrooms in Vice City and check the linked guides for the confirmed method. It is not missable and can be done in free-roam.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. This unlocks by stealing all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs. The alley is marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police, and you do not need to grab all three in one visit — the robbery icon respawns, so you can go back for whatever you missed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, then each character — it is the heart icon. Buy a fitness club membership and always work out together: call your partner with Right plus Triangle, and while one character trains, the other completes their training automatically, doubling your progress. You can only switch between characters after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, and there are fitness clubs all over Vice City, filterable on the map under Activities.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, and a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. Stealthy objectives and clean escapes push you toward Professional, incapacitating enemies toward Hardened, killing toward Violent, mass killing toward Psycho — and Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid excessive violence. Most of the 500 come naturally from robberies and fights while chasing other trophies; if you are short at the end, keep robbing and fighting and it will land.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time’s the charm. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Try returning to the Payday Loans store and repeating whatever you did there the first time, and check the linked guides for the confirmed method. It is not missable.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The exact trigger is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx believes it is tied to a UFO questline. Keep an eye out for strange lights and unexplained events around Leonida, especially at night, and check the linked guides once the UFO questline is mapped. It is not missable.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl ’em over with a melee drive-by. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx believes it is from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. Try knocking enemies down with melee attacks from a moving bike, and check the linked guides for the confirmed method. It is not missable.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative, not in one trip, and bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 each, so it comes naturally while doing robberies for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every purchase counts — guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest because they are the most expensive. There are 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, so just buy what you need as you play and the total climbs on its own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garages — 4 more are story-related and do not count. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone; buy all 8 through the app for $160,000 in total. Robberies are the quickest way to earn the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, which also unlocks Moses himself in Port Gellhorn. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses, choose Respray then Register in his garage — at first he only takes vehicles without trackers, and from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay ’n’ Spray. You need enough garage space first, so buy garages for Little Boxes, and use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the cost down.
